label: Cold War Files

szenen.text: In 1966, the U.S. *lost a hydrogen bomb* off Spain.
January 17: a B-52 *collided* with a refueling tanker.

archiv.datei: File:KC-135A refuels B-52D during Vietnam War.jpg
File:Catalog-26 0007693 413884959 Piction ID KC-135 Refueling B-52 (55627866093).jpg

szenen.text: Both aircraft were *destroyed.* Seven airmen died.
Three fell on land near *Palomares.* Two scattered plutonium.

archiv.datei: File:USS Skill (MSO-471) operating off the coast of Spain, in February 1966 (428-NPC-36556).jpg

szenen.text: The submersible *Alvin* found it nearly 3,000 feet down.
It was raised on *April 7.* How close was that to disaster? Follow for more.

archiv.datei: File:1966 Palomares B-52 crash - recovered H-bomb.jpg
